improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating value props (AI-powered, instant answers, voice chat, free trial). Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial mention reduces friction and encourages clicks.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it serves (trade and business professionals). The subheading reinforces key value props from the site context — instant answers, voice chat, and professional support — while the clear free trial CTA reduces friction and encourages immediate engagement. The copy is concise, avoids unverified claims, and maintains a confident, trustworthy tone aligned with the brand.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, workspace tools, and professional trade and business support. Choose monthly or annual billing—annual members save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel: what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid and emphasizing the low entry price and savings option, it reduces uncertainty and encourages sign-ups.
